newsitem.title: USA: Municipal bond sales total $949 mln for Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Municipal bond sales total $949 mln for Wednesday.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for Wednesday, August 6, were expected to total $949 million in 32 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings totalled $738 million in 17 sales, with a $215 million South Carolina Public Facilities offering through Merrill Lynch & Co. topping the list.
On the competitive side, 15 sales totaling $211 million were scheduled. A $39 million Cache County, Utah, offering at 1130 EDT was the largest.
An additional four sales totaling $148 million were on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues Wednesday depending on market conditions.
